results.caption: Lets go restock our affordable @CeraVe skincare at Target! #skincaretips #CeraVePartner
results.transcript: I heard y'all wanted more affordable skincare, so let's go restock at Target. You guys know I use mostly all affordable skincare because you do not have to spend a lot to get quality products. So I'm making sure to pick up the CeraVe Foaming Facial Cleanser and the CeraVe Facial Moisturizing SPF 50 Lotion. It's a moisturizer and SPF, so it's a two-in-one. And paired with the cleanser, this is a goaded duo, as the kids say. This cleanser is amazing if you have oily skin. And the moisturizer has that SPF and it blends right into the skin. These products won't clog pores and they help promote a stronger skin barrier from day one. So if you're looking for good quality affordable skincare, check out CeraVe. Thank you so much to CeraVe for partnering with me on this video.
